title: From conversation to verifiable task completion
question: Which failures need better prompts, persistent task state or completion checks—and do the gains transfer to a new questionnaire?

coverage.current: Prefix probes can expose wrong interpretations; behavioral omission alone does not prove missed understanding. Preserve unknown attribution.
coverage.needed: Interactive clarification and scoring from information actually revealed so far.

coverage.current: Card-update traces can expose loss even when the final answer is later repaired.
coverage.needed: Field revisions, dependencies, correction propagation and evidence of what remains valid.

coverage.current: Tool failures are logged, but meeting cases lack sufficient business-action gold.
coverage.needed: Action, argument, interpretation and prerequisite checks; multiple valid paths allowed.

coverage.current: Recorded traces can compare a completion judgment with a failed card update.
coverage.needed: Compare every claim with committed business state and delivered confirmation.

scenarios.title: Automotive employee training
scenarios.description: Answer grounded questions, administer a scenario assessment, handle explanations and corrections, then save an evidence-backed evaluation.
scenarios.terminal: Separate correct tutoring, independently demonstrated knowledge and a successfully saved assessment. Mark assisted answers; respect withdrawal.
scenarios.limit: A text assessment is not proof of practical repair skill. New-model vehicle claims require authorized manuals and expert review.

scenarios.title: Telecom offer and change
scenarios.description: Resolve a standard-price request plus implicit loyalty eligibility, explain conditions, obtain acceptance and submit a simulated change.
scenarios.terminal: Offer, acceptance, pending change, applied change and delivered confirmation remain separate states.
scenarios.limit: Use fictional fixed policies and sandbox transactions. No real carrier accounts, payments or email delivery claims.

arms.name: Adapted reference
arms.change: Agent-led / ReAct-style tool choice and free notes; common multi-turn interface.

arms.name: Prompt only
arms.change: B plus reminders to maintain multiple needs, apply corrections and use completion evidence.
arms.contrast: P − B: does a simple prompt suffice?

arms.name: Persistent state
arms.change: P plus per-need/field state, provenance, revisions and dependency updates.

arms.name: Completion check
arms.change: P plus verification of accessible business receipts before claiming completion.

arms.name: Combined
arms.change: P plus both state and completion checks.

stages.label: Discover failures first
stages.description: Six development task families, four conditions each. Review failures before building a candidate mechanism.

stages.label: Compare only justified changes
stages.description: Full design ceiling, including the 48 discovery runs only if every frozen condition matches. Six families remain six clustering units; omit factorial claims if a mechanism branch is stopped.

stages.label: Freeze, then test transfer
stages.description: Twelve new families with two conditions each. Compare P with one common candidate selected before testing. Freeze prompts, schema, code and grading. Cross-domain claims require a new domain.

sources.title: Taskmaster-1 · official data
sources.use: Select two-person automotive WoZ dialogue for human language; retain source IDs and attribution.
sources.limit: Role-play, not naturally occurring company calls. The corpus also contains self-written dialogue. CC BY 4.0; automotive subset not yet extracted.

sources.title: ASE Automobile 2026 · official guide
sources.use: Expert task coverage and knowledge-assessment forms.
sources.limit: Public access does not authorize republishing the question bank; not a new-vehicle manual or dialogue gold.

sources.title: AURACA101 · official competency standard
sources.use: Requirements clarification, outstanding needs and follow-up as rubric inputs.
sources.limit: A competency standard is not a ready-made questionnaire. Redistribution terms have not been verified.

sources.title: ReAct · original paper
sources.use: Interleaved reasoning and acting as a reference strategy.
sources.limit: ReAct does not require the agent to track only one intention; structural failure must be measured.

sources.title: τ²-bench · versioned paper
sources.use: Separate policy, private user task, tools and terminal assertions.
sources.limit: The official repository has evolved to τ³. Pin code, tasks and grader; do not compare unversioned scores.

sources.title: Gaia2 / ARE · versioned paper
sources.use: Dynamic events, dependencies and asynchronous environments.
sources.limit: An asynchronous environment or parallel tools do not imply universal gains.

sources.title: Mind the Sim2Real Gap · versioned paper
sources.use: Motivates independent checks of simulated-user behavior and human anchors.
sources.limit: Simulation outcomes cannot by themselves establish real-user benefit.

sources.title: FormBharo · versioned paper
sources.use: Related work on extraction plus deterministic form-state handling.
sources.limit: Limited form and simulator coverage; per-field correctness is not whole-task success or arbitrary-JSON transfer.

limitations: No new model experiments, human study, clinical task or architecture implementation in this update.
The 48 / 480 / 192 counts are staged planning ceilings, not completed runs or power guarantees. Extra oracle and ablation runs are not included.
Expert-reviewed cases, executable gold and a shared interactive business adapter remain to be built.
State and verification arms initially estimate intervention-package effects, including computation. Matched-budget summary/reviewer controls are required for narrower mechanism claims.
A questionnaire can change through JSON only within a shared schema and operation set; new business operations require an adapter.
Previous research findings and frozen baselines are unchanged.
